concepts.name: The last loaf
concepts.scene: A fictional adult woman at a bright harvest feast is the only guest who has not broken her bread; smiling villagers wait for her first bite.

concepts.name: The returning harvest ribbon
concepts.scene: A fictional adult woman tries to return a harvest-prize ribbon at a rural midday celebration, but the smiling group keeps its receiving hands at its sides.

concepts.name: Seed levy
concepts.scene: A fictional adult woman is stopped at a harvest seed-sorting table where all the other dishes are full but her offered handful is judged in silence.

concepts.name: The unfilled chair
concepts.scene: A fictional adult woman stands behind the sole unfilled chair in a sunlit harvest group portrait, while the assembled guests keep the seat waiting for her.

concepts.name: The shared cup
concepts.scene: A fictional adult woman is last in a harvest-toast circle, holding the communal cup while everyone else lowers their empty raised hands and watches her.
